The *Upapattikathā* (Kv 4.2) is a debate located within the fourth chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The title designates a discussion or discourse concerning rebirth or arising (*upapatti*). SuttaCentral records one modern translation in one language [SuttaCentral]. None of the secondary literature passages in the dossier discuss this specific section of the *Kathāvatthu*, as all surveyed occurrences of *upapatti* pertain instead to general Abhidhamma psychological concepts (such as *upapatti-bhava* or the moment of rebirth), the threefold knowledge (*cuti-upapatti-ñāṇa*), or the epistemological and mathematical use of the Sanskrit term *upapatti* to denote proof or demonstration.
